<b>Shadow Creepers</b> are [[Shadow Creeper (Hollow Knight)|returning]] [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are shell-plated worms that inhabit the deepest depths and require no food or liquid to survive.<ref>Shadow Creeper [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Shell-plated worm found only in the deepest depths. Seems to survive despite consuming no food or liquid."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Shadow Creepers crawl back and forth on floors and walls, dealing {{Damage|1}} on contact.

== Location ==
Shadow Creepers can be found in [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]].
